node.title: The (PAR) rational parametrization of the e = m = 2 (L2) stratum
node.closure: birational parametrization with a determinantal identity and two syzygies
node.statement: At m = 2 (rho = 7, N = 32, R = 16, r = 7, A = 3) let B = (f,g,h,k) have degrees at most 4 and let L be linear with root ell. Then L*Q_0 = f^2-kg, L*Q_1 = fg+hk, L*Q_2 = g^2+hf is a birational parametrization of the entire e = m = 2 (L2) stratum, subject to exactly two conditions at ell, namely (f^2-kg)(ell) = (g^2+hf)(ell) = 0; the parametrization has hit rate 1. It is the determinant det([[f,k],[g,f]] + z[[g,f],[-h,g]]) = (f^2-kg) + z(fg+hk) + z^2(g^2+hf) = L*Q_z. The syzygies f*(g^2+hf) = g*(fg+hk) + h*(f^2-kg) and f*(fg+hk) = g*(f^2-kg) + k*(g^2+hf) hold identically, so the middle condition at ell follows from the outer two except exactly when f(ell) = g(ell) = 0, where it is unconstrained. The image has dimension exactly 18 = 20 + 1 - 2 - 1 with finite fibres both ways. The membership criterion det M(B) = 0 iff gcd(f^2-kg, fg+hk, g^2+hf) != 1 is proved in the forward direction (L divides all three) and measured 1200/1200 over two fields in the converse. Everything is m = 2 specific: the elimination uses deg(f^2-kg) <= deg Q_0 + 1.
